title: Software Development Engineer - I (SDE-1)
description: Amazon is seeking dynamic Software Development Engineers (SDE-1) to build scalable, high-throughput backend microservices powering AWS and Amazon Retail. You will work on distributed systems handling millions of transactions per second.
responsibilities: Design, build and maintain performant services using Java/Python and AWS stack.
Collaborate with Senior Engineers to write clean, unit-tested, scalable code.
Participate in design reviews, operational excellence, and CI/CD automation.
Troubleshoot complex production issues and improve system reliability.
requirements: B.Tech / B.E / M.Tech in Computer Science, IT or related fields (2024-2026 Batch).
Strong proficiency in Core Java, C++, or Python with deep understanding of OOP.
Solid foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms (Arrays, Graphs, DP), and Time Complexity.
Familiarity with DBMS, SQL, REST APIs, and Operating Systems concepts.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description: Join Google's engineering team to tackle planetary-scale challenges. You'll contribute to software components used across Search, YouTube, Android, and Google Cloud, focusing on algorithms, concurrency, and elegant engineering.
responsibilities: Write robust code in C++, Java, Go, or Python adhering to Google code standards.
Develop scalable software systems handling billions of queries.
Analyze latency bottlenecks and optimize algorithm execution.
requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in CS or equivalent field with min. 7.5 CGPA.
Excellence in competitive programming or advanced Data Structures & Algorithms.
Strong grasp of Computer Networks, Concurrency, and Memory Management.

title: Software Engineer - Front End
description: Microsoft 365 team is looking for a passionate Frontend Engineer. You will craft responsive, high-performance web experiences serving hundreds of millions of daily active users worldwide.
responsibilities: Build modular UI components using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS architectures.
Optimize web application performance, accessibility (a11y), and cross-browser compatibility.
Work closely with UX designers, product managers, and backend engineers.
requirements: Strong fundamentals in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, HTML5, and CSS3.
Understanding of web performance, browser rendering pipeline, and REST/GraphQL APIs.
Solid grasp of fundamental Data Structures (Trees, Strings, Graphs).

title: System Engineer (TCS Digital / Prime)
description: TCS is hiring through the National Qualifier Test (NQT) for high-caliber engineers in the Digital & Prime cadres. Selected engineers work on cutting-edge Cloud, AI, and enterprise digital transformation projects.
responsibilities: Participate in full life cycle software development for Fortune 500 global clients.
Work on Cloud migration, Python/Java microservices, and AI-driven automation.
Deploy solutions on Azure/AWS and participate in Agile sprints.
requirements: B.Tech / B.E / MCA / M.Sc graduates with minimum 60% or 6.0 CGPA throughout academics.
No active backlogs at the time of joining.
Clear understanding of Aptitude, Verbal, Logical, and Coding (Data Structures).

title: Specialist Programmer (Power Programmer)
description: Specialist Programmer (SP) is an elite coding role at Infosys requiring mastery in problem-solving and algorithmic thinking. SPs work on core product engineering and high-complexity client architectures.
responsibilities: Write high-performance algorithmic code for enterprise-grade applications.
Design microservices, API integrations, and event-driven architectures.
Mentor junior team members and implement engineering best practices.
requirements: Exceptional algorithmic problem-solving ability tested via HackWithInfy / InfyTQ.
Proficiency in Java, Python, C++, or modern web frameworks.
Thorough understanding of Dynamic Programming, Graph Theory, and DBMS.

title: Associate Software Engineer (ASE)
description: Accenture is hiring Associate Software Engineers. The role offers intensive training in digital technologies, cloud services, and full stack development followed by deployment to global enterprise projects.
responsibilities: Develop, test, and deploy software applications based on client specifications.
Collaborate in cross-functional squads using Agile methodology.
Maintain code repositories, documentation, and automated test suites.
requirements: B.E / B.Tech all streams with 65% or 6.5 CGPA and no current backlogs.
Aptitude, Critical Thinking, Pseudo Code, and Hands-on Coding proficiency.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.

title: Software Development Engineer - Backend
description: Swiggy is seeking backend engineers to supercharge hyperlocal logistics, rapid delivery, and order allocation engines handling millions of live transactions daily.
responsibilities: Build low-latency microservices with Go, Java, or Node.js.
Work with Kafka, Redis, and MySQL to manage high throughput event streams.
Participate in architecture design for hyper-growth scaling.
requirements: 1+ years of backend development experience or strong personal projects/internships.
Strong knowledge of Data Structures, Concurrency, and System Design.
Experience with relational databases and in-memory caches.

title: Software Development Intern (6 Months)
description: Adobe's Product Engineering internship offers hands-on experience building components for Adobe Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and Experience Platform.
responsibilities: Collaborate with senior researchers and engineers on innovative image and document processing algorithms.
Implement performant code in C++ or WebAssembly.
Present project findings to senior leadership at the conclusion of the internship.
requirements: Currently pursuing B.Tech/M.Tech in CS or related field graduating in 2026.
Strong proficiency in C++ and Object-Oriented Design.
Excellent Data Structures, Algorithm design, and problem solving skills.

title: Backend Engineer - Payments
description: Razorpay powers payments for millions of businesses across India. We're hiring engineers to maintain 99.999% uptime on our core payment gateway and settlement pipelines.
responsibilities: Architect idempotent, fault-tolerant payment APIs in Go or PHP.

Ensure adherence to banking compliance and highest financial security standards.
requirements: Sound understanding of transactional databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and locking.
Solid knowledge of Computer Networks, Security (TLS/HTTPS), and DSA.
Strong coding abilities with focus on clean code and test coverage.

title: Graduate Trainee Engineer

Good communication skills and logical reasoning aptitude.
Knowledge of at least one programming language (Java, C, Python).
